entry.title: WES TANK RAPS THE GRINCH - Part Two

media:group.media:title: WES TANK RAPS THE GRINCH - Part Two
media:group.media:description:
Christmas came late this year with another Seuss drop for y'all. I love you. I wanted to get this out before the end of the year so we're just under the wire. Next year I plan to do a proper mix and master of the song and film more b-roll with the Grinch played by Jolie "JOLEE.JPG" Mallmann. Maybe even screen it in a theater and get a giant inflatable grinch to put on my roof. Luckily this happens every year.... Big shouts and thanks to assistant editors Pader Xiong and Lee Judilla.
